verdict.rationale: Interactive API references are a fair axis for an API product, but nothing in the pack shows a try-it console, an in-browser request runner, or runnable examples. The evidence only shows static endpoint listings on the API overview (e.g. count_tokens, GET /v1/models) and an llms.txt index. The OpenAPI probe found no published spec at any candidate path, so there is not even a machine-readable base for an interactive explorer.
